title: Version 0.34.0: UI Polish and Core Fixes
description: Gemini CLI released v0.34.0 with UI improvements, core fixes, new tools, and chat resume footer on sessions. Version 0.33.0 introduced HTTP authentication for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) remote agents with authenticated A2A agent card support. Gemini 3 is now the default model with 'Faster Flash + Smarter Pro' enhancements.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini CLI is still removing parts of code (23 mar 2026)
Starting March 25, 2026, Gemini Pro models will only be accessible via paid subscriptions. Free tier users will be limited to Gemini Flash

title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Students
description: GitHub introduced a new GitHub Copilot Student plan, rebranding the free tier to create a long-term, sustainable Copilot experience tailored specifically for students. Starting March 12, 2026, students with GitHub Education benefits are transitioned to this new plan with limited access to premium AI models.

community_feedback.quote: They're rebranding the free tier as the 'GitHub Copilot Student' plan, which is just the budget version
GitHub is just trying to save costs; the student plan is now the same as the free version available to everyone
The announcement received over 2,874 downvotes and 1,000 comments on GitHub's platform
Multiple 'goodbye github copilot' posts suggest user dissatisfaction with the changes

title: Custom Chart Creation and Interactive Visualizations
description: Anthropic announced that Claude can now create custom charts and interactive visualizations directly in responses. This 'Imagine with Claude' feature enables inline charts, diagrams, calculators, and animations without requiring separate tools, marking a shift toward Claude as an execution layer for data analysis.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code is going mega viral on X
Claude Code is going crazy viral again. People are coming up with wild use cases
4% of GitHub public commits are being authored by Claude Code, projected to reach 20%+ of all daily commits by end of 2026
Many pointed out that Claude could already generate the code for these charts; this just renders it directly
The Claude Code TUI app is pretty solid. I use it heavily and get great results

title: JetBrains Plugin Updates (v1.42.3 and v2.12.14)
description: Windsurf released updates for the JetBrains plugin ecosystem including version 1.42.3 for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go and version 2.12.14, bringing bug fixes and stability improvements to the IDE integration.

title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Installation Support
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App on desktop and mobile devices through Chrome or Edge browsers, allowing users to run Devin as a native application by visiting app.devin.ai. Additionally, Devin gained the ability to schedule its own recurring sessions for automated task execution.

community_feedback.quote: Devin can now schedule its own recurring sessions. Run a task once, and if it goes well, tell Devin to keep doing it

title: Version 2.6: MCP Apps and Team Plugin Marketplace
description: Cursor 2.6 introduced MCP Apps, allowing MCP servers to return interactive HTML interfaces like dashboards, charts, forms, and media viewers that render directly in agent chats. Also added a Team Plugin Marketplace enabling teams to share private plugins via GitHub repositories.

community_feedback.quote: MCP Apps let MCP servers return interactive HTML interfaces, like dashboards, charts, forms, media viewers, that render right in your agent chat
Cursor renderer freezes (100% CPU) on markdown ReDoS when rendering GitHub MCP responses
The MCP ecosystem grew to over 5,000 community-built servers by March 2026
